name: Lacustrine-Palsa
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by an ancient meteor crater. Beyond magnetic pole anomalies, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.

Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it. Glass-bladed grasses chime across the plains whenever the wind finds its voice.
Trade at the pirate hideout changes hands often and quietly. Its current occupants deal fuel for silence and ask no questions about cargo.
Whoever controls platinum controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
